metadata.description: Community-curated collection of Claude Code skills and agent tools

plugins.name: git-tools
plugins.description: Git commit messages (커밋 메시지), PR creation/updates (PR 만들어줘), and commit history cleanup (히스토리 정리). Triggers: 'commit message', 'create PR', 'update PR', 'restructure commits'.

plugins.name: documentation-tools
plugins.description: Technical documentation with accuracy tracking (코드 문서화). Plan, generate, and update documentation with source citations. Triggers: 'plan documentation', 'generate docs', 'update docs from PR'.
